name: Chegg (homework answers)
evidence: Quarterly revenue 77.6% below its Q4 2021 peak; filings cite generative AI and Google AI Overviews; Q3 2026 revenue -40% YoY

name: Stack Overflow
evidence: 965 new questions in Sep 2026 vs 207,169 in Mar 2014; decline began before ChatGPT, then accelerated

name: Tome (AI slide generation)
evidence: Slides product shut down on Apr 30, 2025 at roughly 25M users; team pivoted to a CRM

name: Jasper (early AI copywriting)
evidence: CEO departure and 20% valuation cut in 2023, layoffs in 2025; survived only by moving upmarket

name: Quizlet (flashcards)
evidence: Web visits -29% (1.1B to 782.7M)

name: Grammarly
evidence: Revenue growth fell from 43% to about 12%; rebranded as Superhuman in 2025

name: Duolingo
evidence: Q2 2026 DAU +23% to 58.7M; heavy AI-chatbot users spend more time in the app

name: Booking.com
evidence: Q3 2026 room nights +7%; LLM referrals well below 1% of room nights

name: Strava
evidence: 180M+ users; 2025 revenue about $490M (+32%)

name: Reddit
evidence: 121M DAU, $252M net income; content licensed to Google and OpenAI

name: Figma
evidence: Q2 2026 revenue +48%, third straight quarter of acceleration; management calls AI a tailwind

name: Canva
evidence: $4B ARR, 265M MAU; ChatGPT drives new design projects (growth forecast cut to 20% on AI costs)

name: Notion
evidence: About $865M ARR in Jul 2026 (+82% YoY); over half of ARR from AI-enabled customers

name: Uber (rides)
evidence: Q3 2026 trips +16%, monthly active consumers +14%, five straight quarters of 20%+ gross bookings growth

name: Meituan food delivery
evidence: Sep 2026 daily orders -4–5% YoY, driven by the end of a subsidy war, not AI [confounder]

name: Roblox
evidence: Q3 2026 DAU -9%, bookings -12%, attributed to an exceptional 2025 base; two-year DAU +55% [confounder]

name: Spotify
evidence: Q3 2026 MAU 788M (+11%), subscribers +9%, revenue +16%

name: Oura Ring
evidence: Revenue +74% for the nine months to Jun 2026; ~90% growth expected for the year

name: Youdao Dictionary Pen
evidence: Youdao smart-device revenue -42.6% (Q1 2026) and -31.5% (Q2); mixed causes: price war, deliberate retreat, AI-driven industry shift

name: Zhihu
evidence: Revenue -22% (Q3 2025) and -10.7% (Q1 2026); paying members down; AI attribution indirect

name: Xiaohongshu (RedNote)
evidence: MAU 400M+, but total time spent -1% and time per user -4% in May 2026, the first decline since 2020; Nomura attributes it to users turning to AI for information [mild]

name: Fiverr (freelance marketplace)
evidence: Q3 2026 active buyers -25.8%, marketplace revenue -24.7%; CEO calls SEO nearly dead and says AI is absorbing low-value tasks

name: Shutterstock (stock images)
evidence: Revenue -18% (Q1 2026) and -17% (Q2); subscribers down; Getty cites AI search and generative AI

name: Yelp (local reviews)
evidence: Q3 2026 revenue -1%, ad revenue -6%, ad clicks -8%; AI data-licensing revenue +82% but small

name: Udemy (video courses)
evidence: Q1 2026 revenue -4%, consumer segment -19% (transactional -30%); merged into Coursera in May 2026

name: Keep (follow-along workouts)
evidence: MAU down from 22.5M to 18.6M (36.4M peak in 2022); online membership revenue -26.9%; decline predates AI [confounder]

name: Wix (website builder)
evidence: Q3 2026 revenue +13%, bookings +11%, driven largely by the acquired AI builder Base44; agency channel slowing

name: Bilibili
evidence: Q2 2026 DAU 117M (+7%), total time +14%, revenue +8%; AI-knowledge content time +72%

name: LinkedIn
evidence: FY2026 revenue +11%; double-digit member growth; AI recruiter tools driving revenue

name: Nextdoor (neighborhood network)
evidence: Q3 2026 weekly actives 24.5M (+14%, third straight quarter of growth), revenue +14%

name: Substack (paid newsletters)
evidence: 5M+ paid subscriptions; ~35M monthly actives (about 20M in 2025)

name: Discord
evidence: 200M+ MAU and growing; IPO delay is a capital-markets factor

name: Quora
evidence: Traffic down YoY; answer contributors -13%; community diluted by AI content

name: SMZDM (deal-sharing community)
evidence: Revenue +2.8% for the first three quarters of 2026, but AI-related revenue rose from 32M to 108M RMB, implying the legacy business fell about 7%

name: Wikipedia (readers)
evidence: Human pageviews -8% YoY; the Foundation attributes it to AI search summaries

name: Tripadvisor (reviews site)
evidence: Q3 2026 Hotels & Other revenue -23%; $370M goodwill impairment attributed to lasting traffic loss from search changes

name: Glassdoor (company reviews)
evidence: Merged into Indeed in Jul 2026 alongside AI-framed layoffs; no standalone usage data [weak evidence]

name: NerdWallet (financial product comparison)
evidence: Q3 2026 revenue +11% (loans, deposits); credit-card and SMB lines hit by organic-search pressure; weak Q4 guide due to auto insurance [confounder]

name: Zillow (listings)
evidence: Q3 2026 revenue +7% in a weak housing market; monthly uniques -3%; ~80% of traffic is direct

name: Etsy (handmade marketplace)
evidence: Q3 2026 GMS +8.8%; active buyers grew YoY for the first time in two years
